s.t: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Our Product Managers imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research.

They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.

Airbnb is seeking an exceptional product manager to reimagine how guests search on Airbnb. Search is the front door to the entire guest experience — the moment someone tells us what they want and we have to understand it, then show them the right options in the right order. Today that means query understanding, filtering, and ranking.

Tomorrow it means next-generation AI capabilities that let guests search more naturally, get better matches with less effort, and trust that Airbnb understood what they were actually looking for.
In this role, you will own the vision and roadmap for the future of search at Airbnb — pushing beyond keyword and filter-based search toward more intelligent, conversational, and personalized ways for guests to find their perfect stay. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, and data science teams to bring new AI-powered search capabilities from concept to guests.
This is a high-visibility role building one of the most consequential surfaces in the guest experience, and will regularly interface with senior engineering and leadership stakeholders.

Define and drive the long-term vision and roadmap for the future of search on Airbnb, including next-generation AI capabilities like natural language and conversational search, query understanding, and intelligent ranking.
Own how guests search on Airbnb end to end — from the moment they express intent to the moment they find the right option.
Partner closely with engineering, applied ML, and data science teams to design, prototype, and ship AI-powered search experiences.
Use quantitative analysis and experimentation (A/B testing) to validate that new search capabilities improve relevance, conversion, and guest satisfaction.
Translate ambiguous guest problems into clear product requirements, prioritized against business impact and technical feasibility.
Collaborate with design and research to understand how guests search, filter, and decide today — and where AI can remove friction.
Work cross-functionally with Host-side and Trust teams to ensure smarter search continues to surface the right inventory fairly and accurately.
Communicate roadmap, results, and trade-offs clearly to engineering partners and leadership.

10+ years of consumer product management experience, with a track record of owning a product area end to end.
Experience working on search, discovery, ranking, or recommendation systems is strongly preferred.
Genuine excitement about applying modern AI and ML capabilities (LLMs, semantic search, conversational interfaces) to consumer product problems.
Strong business acumen and ability to use data, research, and experimentation to drive product strategy and decisions.
Demonstrated ability to work closely with ML/data science teams and understand the trade-offs of model-driven products.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills across engineering, design, data science, and other cross-functional teams.
A user-centered mindset — you dig into how guests actually search and where they get stuck, not just metrics dashboards.

Due to the nature of this position, there is a strong preference for the successful applicant will need to be based in San Francisco, CA to be able to conduct their work. Currently, employees can not be located in: Alaska, Indiana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota, Wisconsin, Alabama, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Delaware And Rhode Island.

This list is continuously being updated, please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Who we are
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet.
Stripe Apps connect Stripe with the tools businesses already use, bringing relevant data and workflows into the Stripe Dashboard and third-party systems. The Strategic Apps team owns a portfolio of integrations with enterprise systems that are critical to our users’ workflows—from quote-to-cash and support to reporting. We help users embed Stripe more deeply into the way they run their businesses.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to set the strategy and lead execution for Strategic Apps. You will own a portfolio of existing and new integrations, including those with systems such as Salesforce, and determine where Stripe should invest based on user needs, Stripe’s product and industry priorities, and market signals. You will work across Stripe and directly with external partners to deliver reliable, high-quality integrations that drive adoption and business outcomes.
Own the vision, product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a portfolio of strategic apps, making and communicating clear trade-offs amid significant ambiguity.
Identify, prioritize, and validate the highest-value user problems and integration opportunities through direct user research, ecosystem analysis, and quantitative evidence.
Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Sales, User Support, Marketing, Partner Management, and other product teams to deliver and evolve integrations end to end.
Partner with Engineering to define product requirements, technical approach, and quality standards for integrations, including APIs, documentation, edge cases, reliability, security, compliance, and ongoing maintenance.
Establish feedback loops and measurement plans before launch; use product, business, and user metrics to assess efficacy, diagnose changes in performance, and continuously improve adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes.
Represent Stripe’s product strategy with strategic technology partners and enterprise users, building productive relationships with product and technical counterparts and incorporating their feedback into roadmap decisions.
Drive launches, beta programs, user acceptance testing, and go-to-market readiness in partnership with Marketing, Sales, Partner Management, and Support; ensure teams have the materials and operating model needed to support adoption at scale.
Make and drive important cross-functional decisions, align senior stakeholders around a shared strategy, and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly.
Balance new feature development with investment in quality, reliability, technical debt, and foundational platform capabilities across the app portfolio.
Improve how Stripe builds and operates strategic integrations by turning user, partner, and performance signals into scalable product and process improvements.

8+ years of relevant product-management, engineering, or equivalent experience, including ownership of a high-quality product or feature area at scale or a major evolution of an existing product.
Experience setting product strategy and driving execution across multiple cross-functional teams or a complex product area, from ambiguous problem definition through launch and iteration.
Demonstrated ability to use qualitative and quantitative evidence to define success metrics, evaluate product performance, and make prioritization decisions.
Strong technical judgment and fluency working with engineers on API-based products, integrations, technical constraints, and product quality.
Experience engaging directly with enterprise users and external technology partners, and translating their needs into clear product decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and leading through organizational boundaries.

Experience with enterprise business systems and workflows, such as CRM, ERP, quote-to-cash, support, or reporting platforms; familiarity with Salesforce, Oracle, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics is a plus.
Experience building or scaling platform, ecosystem, marketplace, or partner-integrated products.
Experience growing product adoption, usage, or revenue through product-led and go-to-market initiatives.
Experience in payments, financial technology, or other regulated technology environments.
A degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Stripe's Professional Services (ProServ) team helps businesses around the world design, implement, and optimise their Stripe integrations. As we scale our global delivery capability, we are building a structured portfolio of service offerings that define the scope, methodology, resourcing, and commercial terms of how we engage with our users.

We are looking for a Product Manager ( Professional Services) to own the portfolio of offerings end-to-end. The role sits at the intersection of services strategy, commercial design, and delivery operations. You will be the person who determines whether our offerings are well-designed, effectively sold, and profitably delivered and you will take action to refine the portfolio as needed.
This is not a traditional Product Manager role, but it demands the same rigour. Your "product" is the service itself: its scope, its pricing, its methodology, and its performance. You will work closely with Sales, Delivery, Finance, and Stripe's Product organisation to ensure that every offering in our portfolio is fit for purpose and continuously improving.

Own the offering portfolio for Professional Services
Maintain and govern ProServ’s offering portfolio including scope, hours, pricing, and resource plans for each offering. Our portfolio includes offerings designed for all user segments from start-ups to enterprises
Manage the full offering lifecycle: design, build, launch, iterate, and deprecate offerings based on market need, delivery performance, and product roadmap changes
Ensure the portfolio stays current as Stripe launches new products
Design and implement a governance framework for the portfolio of offerings
Drive offering performance analytics
Define and track the offering KPIs: attach rate, average scope deviation, planned vs. actual burn rate, gross margin per offering, and customer satisfaction
Run regular performance reviews and present findings to ProServ leadership with clear recommendations
Refine and Improve Offering Design
Analyse delivery burn data to identify offerings that are systematically over- or under-scoped, and propose refinements
Conduct structured retrospectives with Delivery Leads after engagement close to capture insights and feedback
Serve as the structured feedback loop between Delivery (what is hard to deliver), Sales (what is hard to sell), and Finance (what is margin-accretive), synthesising those inputs into offering design decisions

Required
7+ years of Professional Services or consulting delivery experience
Demonstrable experience shaping or owning a service offering
Commercial literacy
Strong analytical skills
Excellent written communication
Product Management training or experience
The ability to apply product thinking (hypothesis, prototype, measure, iterate) to service design

Familiarity with Certinia and/or Salesforce
Exposure to partner and SI ecosystem dynamics

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
TwoTwenty is Pinterest's incubation team. We invented Shuffles and Collages and we're the team behind Beauty Guides, Restyle and Smart Blocks. We're hiring a product manager to own one of our shipping products end to end, or to lead one of our next zero-to-one bets from a blank page to real users.

Own a product on TwoTwenty end to end, from strategy through post-launch iteration. You'll pick between a substantial slice of the teams AI Experiences charter or one of the team's next bets in areas like generative creation tools, live shopping or AI planning surfaces.
Make the product decisions that separate a demo from a product. You'll decide what ships in V1, defend the cut list and set the quality bar on your surface so designers and engineers calibrate to it.
Land launches that require alignment with partner teams inside Pinterest (AIFwd, Search, Shop with Pinterest, ATG). You'll get to agreement without needing your manager in the room.
Translate a company-level thesis into a concrete product decision your team can build against. You'll be able to state your product's strategy in one sentence and connect this week's engineering work to it.
Run experiments that answer real questions, not experiments that produce metrics. You'll decide when a null result is a launch signal and when a positive result isn't good enough.
Use AI to accelerate exploration, drafting and analysis in your day-to-day. This includes prototyping concepts, comparing design options and synthesizing user research, while applying judgment and verification to protect correctness and quality.
Mentor at least one PM or designer on the team on the craft of narrowing a problem before writing the doc.

Minimum of 6 years of product management experience, including shipping a consumer product with an AI or ML component to at least one million users.
Experience owning a zero-to-one product from a blank page through real user traffic, not a prototype in a deck.
Experience saying no to a well-liked feature request from an executive and holding the line on quality.
Experience earning the trust of a senior engineering leader on architectural decisions, and can describe how you did it.
Understanding of the difference between a strategy and a plan, and the ability to state your current team's strategy in one sentence.
Experience using AI to accelerate product exploration, competitive analysis or user research synthesis, with a clear approach to validating accuracy and quality before decisions get made.
Committed to owning outcomes end to end. You treat things outside your scope as yours when the product needs it, and you don't lean on process to make decisions the team is looking to you for.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as computer science, design, human-computer interaction or business, or equivalent experience.

The Programmatic Ads team at Pinterest builds the foundation for scalable and automated advertising through integrations with top demand-side platforms (DSPs), supply-side platforms (SSPs), and other partners. We design and deliver programmatic solutions that respect the user’s discovery experience while maximizing value for advertisers. As digital advertising rapidly evolves, we’re on a mission to set Pinterest apart through powerful, transparent, and measurable programmatic ad offerings.
We are seeking an experienced product leader to drive the next phase of growth in programmatic advertising at Pinterest.
As Staff Product Manager, Programmatic Ads, you will define, build, and scale our suite of programmatic advertising products and integrations. You’ll play a pivotal role in driving the product vision, roadmap, and cross-functional execution to enable advertisers and partners to seamlessly transact across Pinterest’s rapidly growing ad marketplace.

Collaborate with product leadership to help define and execute the roadmap for Pinterest’s programmatic ad offerings, ensuring alignment with business goals and advertiser needs.
Work closely with engineering, sales, partnerships, ad operations, data science, and design to build products that drive adoption, performance, and satisfaction among advertisers.
Prioritize product initiatives, balancing immediate customer needs with longer-term scalability and automation opportunities.
Develop a strong understanding of the programmatic ad ecosystem (including DSPs, SSPs, auction mechanics, and deal types) to inform product decisions and ensure competitive differentiation.
Deliver features and tools that provide actionable insights, streamlined workflows, and effective reporting for programmatic buyers and Pinterest’s internal teams.
Leverage data and user feedback to inform product prioritization, track success metrics, and recommend enhancements
Partner with designers to create intuitive interfaces, dashboards, and reporting tools for programmatic workflows.
Serve as a key resource on programmatic ad products within the team and across partner functions.

5+ years of Product Management experience, with a demonstrated record of launching and improving advertising or ad tech products, ideally in programmatic or related spaces.
Experience building products that use data and insights to support business users and drive measurable growth.
Practical knowledge of programmatic ad technology (bid requests/responses, auction mechanics, deal types such as PMP, PG, Open Auction).
Familiarity with building workflow or reporting tools for advertisers, agencies or internal operations teams.
Experience partnering with DSPs, SSPs, agencies, or other third-party ad platforms.
Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with a data-driven approach to delivering business impact.
Comfort working with cross-functional teams in a fast-moving environment.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.

HER is the world’s largest community for lesbian, bisexual, and queer people. We’re a global, subscription-based consumer product serving millions of LGBTQIA+ users across 55+ countries — helping people connect, date, and build community in ways that feel authentic, affirming, and fun.
HER is part of Match Group, the global leader in dating products, and sits within Match Group’s Everyone & Everywhere (E&E) portfolio alongside other identity-led platforms. This gives us the best of both worlds: the scale, insight, and infrastructure of a global organization, with the autonomy, speed, and cultural focus of a small, mission-driven team.
We're hiring a Product Manager I to own product execution at HER on a 9-month temporary basis. You'll run the day-to-day product/engineering sprint cadence — standups, planning, backlog grooming, unblocking — while also shaping what's on the roadmap: pitching ideas and weighing in on feature and design discussions. This is not a pure execution role. On a small, senior team, you'll have real ownership and a direct line to the people building HER's brand and product vision.

Sprint & Execution Ownership
Run the product/engineering sprint cadence — standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retros
Keep releases on track and unblock engineering as issues arise
Translate roadmap priorities into clear, well-scoped tickets and specs
Roadmap & Ideation
Contribute original ideas to the roadmap — this role is expected to pitch, not just deliver
Weigh in on feature scoping and design discussions alongside Design, Data/Analytics, and Engineering
Use data and qualitative insight to prioritize what gets built next
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Design, Data/Analytics, Engineering, and CRM to ship high-quality experiences
Coordinate periodically (roughly every other week) with the broader Emerging & Evergreen product team
Build relationships with HER's Head of Product and founder to stay aligned with brand vision
Data-Informed Decision-Making
Use product analytics to inform prioritization and measure the impact of shipped work
Design and interpret experiments in partnership with Data/Analytics

Serving public sector customers is an integral part of ServiceNow 's business and future growth trajectory. ServiceNow is a leading provider of digital workflows for many federal, state, and local government agencies in the United States.

To help these organizations successfully fulfill their missions and deliver better experiences to citizens and constituents, ServiceNow provides specialized cloud environments that meet and exceed the data and security regulations and policies of our government customers.

These environments span ServiceNow -hosted regulated clouds, customer-managed and partner-operated deployments, and emerging sovereign offerings.

ServiceNow is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own strategy and execution across our U.S. Public Sector cloud platforms — a portfolio that includes our regulated ServiceNow -hosted environments (e.g., GCC and NSC), our self-hosted and partner-operated Private Stack deployments.
In this senior individual-contributor role you will define how the ServiceNow platform operates across isolated, customer-managed, and partner-hosted environments, setting cross-domain strategy and driving parity with our commercial cloud while meeting stringent compliance, security, and sovereignty requirements.

You will shape the market point of view for regulated public sector, own multi-quarter strategy and roadmap, and directly influence the roadmap of the broader ServiceNow Platform to better serve this specialized segment of customers.
You will operate at the intersection of platform architecture, compliance, and go-to-market, leading multi-team and multi-VP programs and aligning engineering, security, GTM, legal, and partner ecosystems. Reporting into the Regulated Markets & Public Sector product organization, you will be a key member of a team that drives the growth of ServiceNow 's public sector business.
Your product portfolio
Regulated ServiceNow -hosted clouds — Own strategy and roadmap for offerings (e.g., GCC, NSC) supporting U.S. federal, state, local, and other regulated public sector customers, aligned to frameworks such as FedRAMP, DoD IL4/IL5, CJIS, and FIPS.
Self-hosted / Private Stack (incl. Private Stack Pro) — Own strategy for customer-managed and partner-operated deployments, driving the containerized, scalable Private Stack Pro deployment model and the official Private Stack go-to-market.
Pro & sovereign offerings — Own roadmap, packaging, and GTM strategy for Pro hosted deployments and emerging sovereign asks, including new-market entry evaluation.
Partner & ecosystem model — Define how partners deliver ServiceNow as a regulated and sovereign platform, setting operating models, certification approaches, and GTM strategy.
What you get to do in this role
Own cross-domain product strategy and a multi-quarter roadmap across the U.S. public sector cloud portfolio, balancing parity, compliance-driven capabilities, and platform scalability across offerings.
Shape the market point of view for regulated public sector, anticipating parity blockers and validating federal, DoD, and SLED nuances (e.g., ATO, boundary, connectivity).
Define scalable compliance and security patterns (e.g., pre-authorization guardrails) with legal, compliance, OCISO, and security teams, anticipating NIST/TLS/CMMC deltas and de-risking early.
Partner with engineering to set architecture direction across deployment models ( ServiceNow -hosted, customer-managed, partner-hosted, disconnected/air-gapped), containerization, and security, identity, and connectivity approaches.
Industrialize release patterns for regulated GA — planning SCR bundles, aligning QE/SRE gates, resolving cross-team blockers, and implementing operational metrics (lead time, change-fail rate).
Lead multi-team and multi-VP programs, influencing OCISO, legal, and infrastructure leadership to unblock delivery and align on strategy.
Design GTM motions with Legal and enable the field — positioning, FAQs, RFP responses, architecture guidance, and playbooks — to reduce sales friction across Private Stack, Pro, and sovereign offerings.
Own data-driven prioritization: balance capacity, cost, and revenue with scenario planning; tie investment to NNACV; and drive business cases and New Market Entry analysis tied to TAM and CACV.
Standardize specification and communication templates across the organization and set the documentation bar for regulated offerings; monitor competitive intelligence as an input into product strategy.
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
5+ years of B2B product management experience in platform or cloud infrastructure.
Experience with enterprise software, cloud architectures, or deployment platforms (familiarity with SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS models).
Proven ability to set strategy and lead cross-functional, multi-team initiatives in complex, ambiguous, and dynamic environments.
U.S. Citizenship and located within the United States.

Deep knowledge of sovereign cloud / regulated environments and self-hosted or customer-managed deployments.
Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, CJIS, IL4/IL5, NIST, and FIPS.
Experience with Kubernetes / containerization strategies and partner ecosystem models (MSP, sovereign operators).
Experience working with the U.S. federal government and broader public sector.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder-alignment skills, with a premium for precision and clarity of language.

Our Connected Customer Experiences organization is scaling a portfolio of AI-powered capabilities designed to help customers resolve issues quickly and effectively, with AI increasingly able to complete resolutions without requiring human involvement. These capabilities are core to how ServiceNow proves that AI can operate reliably at enterprise scale — on our own platform, for our own customers.

ServiceNow is looking for a Principal Inbound Product Manager to build the evaluation and feedback backbone that makes our AI-powered support products trustworthy, measurable, and continuously improving. We are investing in building structured mechanism for statistical sampling, human review, or feedback capture that closes the loop back into the product. This role owns enabling that mechanism from the ground up, and applying it consistently across all AI-enabled products in the portfolio.
This is an inbound-facing role: your primary customers are the product teams and Customer Support teams across the organization, and your core deliverable is the evaluation & governance infrastructure, taxonomy, and process that lets every AI feature get measurably better over time.
What You'll Own
End-to-end design of the AI product evaluation ecosystem: automated evals, human-in-the-loop review, and a structured feedback taxonomy applied consistently across the organization's AI-enabled support capabilities.
A closed-loop process that converts feedback and review findings into concrete product and model improvements.
Cross-functional coordination across Product, AI/ML Engineering, Data & Telemetry, and AI Operations to unify how feedback is captured, reviewed, and actioned.
The requirements and prioritization inputs that drive continuous improvement in resolution quality and effectiveness, benefiting both internal support teams and external customers.
Why This Role Matters
Own the foundational trust layer for ServiceNow 's AI-powered support products at a moment when the company is scaling AI features faster than it can currently validate them.
Shape how ServiceNow itself, not just our customers — operationalizes responsible, data-driven AI product development, with direct executive visibility.
Sit at the intersection of product, data science, and operations, with the mandate to build something that doesn't exist today rather than optimize an existing process.

The Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate has built products where an intelligent discovery layer is the differentiator — where the ability to surface the right knowledge, in the right context, for the right user is what makes the product worth using. They understand what it takes to make that experience feel effortless, and they bring the technical depth to engage meaningfully with engineers and architects on how to build it.
They are comfortable in the ambiguity of a brand new product. They don’t need a mature backlog or a well-worn playbook — they can create structure where none exists, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and keep a complex roadmap moving without losing sight of the long-term vision.
They think in systems. They understand that a platform serving customers, internal consultants, and peer product managers simultaneously requires architectural thinking, not just feature thinking.
They are a natural connector. In a role that sits at the center of platform, solutions, and services, they build trust quickly, communicate with clarity, and have a track record of aligning diverse stakeholders around a shared direction.

Company Overview At Motorola Solutions , we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places.

Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

"Solving for safer" is at the heart of everything we do, and the Global Process Organization (GPO) is essential to this mission. As a Product Manager for Subscription & Experience Transformation, you will be the strategic driver and execution anchor responsible for defining, designing, and delivering the end-to-end global processes that power our renewals and subscription business.
Job Description In this role, you will act as both an "Experience Architect" and a "Delivery Champion." You will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution—owning the product roadmap, mapping complex global processes, and partnering with technical teams to ensure our core platforms (i.e. Salesforce, Oracle, etc) deliver a seamless customer and agent experience. Key Responsibilities 1. Roadmap & Program Ownership (The "PM" Lens)
End-to-End Delivery: Drive the lifecycle of subscription and renewal initiatives from initial scoping through to deployment, ensuring projects stay on track and deliver business value.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the central connective tissue between regional business leadership, Finance, Sales Operations, and IT infrastructure teams to manage project dependencies and mitigate risks.
Stakeholder Management: Facilitate workshops and governance meetings to communicate project status, align competing priorities, and drive global consensus.
2. Process Design & Experience Architecture (The "CX" Lens)
Process Mapping: Document "As-Is" and "To-Be" global processes using visual tools such as Visio or Lucidchart to simplify complex renewal lifecycles, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and unlock automation.
Experience Design: Visualize process changes through wireframes or low-fidelity prototypes to ensure a seamless, intuitive user interface for internal teams and external customers.
Data-Driven Insights: Analyze data from diverse sources—user clicks, subscription metrics (ARR, churn), support tickets, and financial reports—to build compelling, data-backed business cases for process improvements.
3. Technical Translation & Execution (The "TPO" Lens)
Requirements Gathering: Translate complex business rules regarding subscription mechanics (e.g., co-terming, upsells, automated renewals) into clear, actionable user stories and functional specifications.
Platform Alignment: Partner closely with technical delivery teams to ensure process designs are highly feasible and optimally configured within core enterprise platforms like Oracle, Salesforce, and ServiceNow.
Change Management Support: Develop training materials, FAQ documentation, and "Day in the Life" guides to ensure high global adoption of newly implemented tools and processes.

The "Architect" Mindset: A natural affinity for deconstructing messy, highly technical subscription and billing problems into clean, logical, and optimized operational flows.
Communication Excellence: Proven ability to bridge the gap between deeply technical development teams and non-technical business stakeholders, explaining complex configuration dependencies with ease.
Agile Proficiency: Deep familiarity with Agile methodologies, product backlog prioritization, and sprint planning.
Subscription Ecosystem Knowledge: Direct experience working within subscription-based business models, CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) systems, or enterprise ERP/CRM billing platforms is highly desirable.
Global Adaptability: Comfort and competence working across different time zones, cultures, and matrixed corporate environments.

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year.

Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally.

This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

When a contractor in Brazil gets paid on time, a business in Singapore settles in the right currency, or a payroll platform moves money to 40 countries without a single failure: that's what a good payments platform looks like from the outside. From the inside, it's hard decisions about which rails to build on, what reliability means at scale, and how to make a platform handling billions a month behave consistently across markets with completely different rules.
Nium processes cross-border payments for banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms across 100+ countries. The Senior PM - Payments Platform owns the rails those payments run on.

Reliability. Define what "good" looks like for corridor performance, settlement success, and straight-through processing. Set the targets, own them, move them.

Corridor and market design . Each market has its own mechanics and failure modes. You translate that into requirements: what the corridor supports, how failure is handled, what go-live looks like, so the products built on top can make promises to customers and keep them.

Integration standards. You set the bar for what gets built with correspondent banks, local networks, and processors globally. You decide which integrations are worth doing, weighing partner economics and business impact against build and maintenance cost, and you push the ones that matter through to delivery.

Resilience. Design for failure: redundancy, failover, degraded modes. The goal is a platform where a single rail going down doesn't mean customers feel it.

AI and agentic payment flows . This is the frontier. Payments infrastructure today is reactive: something breaks, someone fixes it. We want infrastructure that thinks: routes intelligently, detects degradation before customers feel it, reconciles autonomously, resolves failures without human escalation. Nium wants to be the first payments infrastructure company to make agentic flows core to how money moves. You define what that looks like and build it.

Payments experience at real scale: high volume, multi-market, genuine accountability when things break. You understand the mechanics (settlement windows, return codes, reconciliation, failure handling) well enough to bring unambiguous requirements.

Curious about how payments work across markets. AI-native in how you work. Rigorous about prioritization. Opinionated, not passive: you form a point of view on how a corridor or integration should work, and you push it forward rather than waiting to be told what to build.

You push Engineering on trade-offs and bring them along with you, holding ground on what's right for the corridor and the business without needing positional authority to do it. And above all, you are passionate about the customer outcome at the end of the transaction, not the platform for its own sake.

3-5 years in product management. Payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure is a requirement. Experience with real-time rails (UPI, SEPA, RTP, Pix, or equivalents) is a strong plus.

The Opportunity

Most payments PMs work on one market, one rail, one product type. Here you work on all of them simultaneously: Asia-Pacific, Americas, Europe, MENA, all with different mechanics and failure modes. The exposure you get in two years compresses what usually takes a decade.

The team is small, senior, and ambitious. The infrastructure you build will process tens of billions of dollars a month and affect the finances of real people and businesses, including the first generation of payments that run through AI agents rather than human-initiated flows.

How We’ll Measure You

Corridor success rate and STP rate, moved quarter over quarter.

Settlement failure rate and time-to-resolution.

Integration delivery against committed dates.

Reduction in payment failures from platform-layer decisions.

Deine Mission
KI-Features liefern, die Zahlen bewegen: Du verantwortest KI-Features end-to-end – Belegerkennung, Klassifizierung, automatisches Verfassen von Steuer-Antwortschreiben, RAG über Mandantenakten. Werde besessen vom Nutzer: Du betreibst Discovery auf die harte Tour: Interviews, Shadowing-Sessions, Synthese von Rohfeedback. Du gehst tief genug, um echte von angenommenen Problemen zu unterscheiden – und wirst zur schärfsten Stimme des Nutzers in deiner Produktlinie.
Verantworte die Roadmap, verteidige die Trade-offs: Du verantwortest die Roadmap deiner Produktlinie end-to-end. Priorisierung über Geschäftswert, technische Machbarkeit und regulatorische Passung. Halte die Messlatte beim Design: Du setzt einen hohen visuellen Standard und schützt ihn. Figma-Souveränität auf Review- und Skizzen-Niveau: Du entwirfst Flows, kritisierst Komponenten und blockst alles ab, was den Standard nicht erfüllt. Die beste Steuer-UX ist unsichtbar – mach unsere unsichtbar.
Laufe auf Daten, nicht auf Bauchgefühl: Du definierst die KPIs, die zählen – Time-to-Filing, Automatisierungsrate, Mandantenzufriedenheit, Berater-Effizienz – und steuerst jede Iteration aus Dashboards. Bauchgefühl bringt hier keine Features in Produktion.
Treibe die KI-Frontier: Du folgst der KI-Debatte nicht – du treibst sie. Evals, Prompt-Iteration, Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs in Produktion. Du experimentierst unermüdlich mit dem Möglichen und bringst die Speerspitze ins Produkt.

KI-Begeisterung: Du nutzt KI-Produkte täglich, kritisierst sie öffentlich oder privat und hast scharfe Ansichten dazu, wohin sie sich entwickeln. Praktische Vertrautheit mit Claude Cowork/Design/Code, GPT, Gemini o. Ä. ist die Baseline.
Selbst-Umsetzung: Du wartest nicht darauf, entblockt zu werden. Du prototypst, testest Prompts, verdrahtest Integrationen, hackst zusammen, was nötig ist. Wenn etwas blockiert ist, entblockst du es.
Strukturiertes Denken: MECE, First Principles, hypothesengetrieben. Du verdichtest Ambiguität zu klaren Entscheidungen – nicht zu weiteren Foliensätzen.
Kommunikation: Exzellentes Englisch (C2). Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus.
Domänen-Hintergrund: Erfahrung in Finance, Tax, Accounting oder angrenzenden Domänen ist ein starkes Plus – ebenso Vertrautheit mit Accounting-/Finance-Software-Stacks, DATEV, ELSTER oder regulierten Datenworkflows.

The Position
This is an exciting time to join Remote and build a thriving ecosystem of HRIS integrations as a Senior Product Manager, HRIS Integrations .
Your mission: enable customers to sync their HRIS with Remote's employment infrastructure for Payroll, EOR, and Contractors through reliable, well-designed technical integrations. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, Sales, and Customer Success, you will bring the detail orientation, collaboration, and customer judgment needed to build integrations that work exceptionally well, solve real customer problems, and drive customer outcomes.
You report to a Senior Group Product Manager and collaborate daily with Engineering, Design, GTM, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure every HRIS integration succeeds commercially and technically.

Partner-Facing Experience: Proven experience building trusted relationships with external organizations and communicating clearly in partner-facing settings.
Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to align cross-functional stakeholders, navigate trade-offs, and keep teams focused on what matters most for customers.

Product Manager Specific Solutions
DECTRIS is a successful and expanding high\-tech company that develops and produces X\-ray and electron detectors. Our detectors are used worldwide in large\-scale research facilities and in industry. Their unique properties enable scientific breakthroughs in life sciences and material sciences.

Our more than 170 employees are located in Switzerland, the United States and Japan. At DECTRIS, we combine innovation and development with agile industry practices. As a spin\-off of the Institute and by focusing on the needs of our customers, we are able to combine scientific excellence with qualified service and industrial know\-how.
Our scientists as well as our technical and commercial experts ensure that our customers benefit from the latest technologies.
DECTRIS values collaborative working rather than traditional hierarchy and is guided by the principles of Sociocracy 3\.0\.
Your Tasks
Proactive Customer Interaction: Systematically track customers' upgrade cycles and facility roadmaps to engage in technical design dialogues pre\-tender, influencing specifications early, and harvesting the full potential of our markets
Strategic Portfolio Balancing: Strategically qualify Specific Solutions projects when standard options are unviable or selectively to demonstrate DECTRIS' cutting\-edge custom capabilities
Strategic Evaluation: Evaluate whether a customer request should be handled as a customized detector or if it signals the need for a new standard product
Requirements Engineering: Coordinate with customers and Area Sales Managers to determine detector requirements, setup details, and application backgrounds
Technical Feasibility: Collaborate with technical experts to estimate feasibility, risks, effort, time, and costs for novel designs
Proposal Management: Provide Sales with technical concepts, price estimations, and lead times to create winning offers
Project Oversight: Maintain a clear overview of ongoing projects and keep all internal and external stakeholders informed
Balancing Interests: Find pragmatic solutions that match the customer's timeline and budget while protecting DECTRIS' interests and technical standards
Visibility and Outreach: Represent Specific Solutions at conferences, user meetings, and facility visits; turn completed custom builds into reference cases and application stories that seed the next generation of requests
Your Skills
Science/engineering degree or similar, previous experience in product management or project management is an asset
Strong understanding of X\-ray technology, vacuum systems, and related equipment. You can quickly grasp the capabilities and boundaries of our standard products
Excellent skills in interacting with various stakeholders, from scientists in international research facilities to internal cross\-functional teams
Ability to identify and reduce technical risks and suggest pragmatic solutions
Understanding of how market trends and customers' needs can be leveraged to enhance business outcomes
You understand where the X\-ray markets, its applications, and customer needs are heading, and you can translate that into which custom requests are worth pursuing
Proven ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple customer requests simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines
You are precise in creating and updating project and product documentation

A successful and growing high tech company in an international, scientific environment
To join the global leader in HPC X\-ray detectors for science and industry. Our Developers design cutting\-edge detectors to support the state of the art science and technology
An international work environment formed by more than 170 experienced engineers, scientists and other professionals. The company languages are German and English
Excellent, flexible working arrangements to enable professional development and personal life balance
An attractive working environment: modern infrastructure with wheelchair\-accessible rooms, small fitness room, underground car park, subsidised meals, free snacks and drinks, various company events, internal and external training, home office options, after\-work beers and other joint leisure activities

This role directly impacts conversion, liquidity, and revenue optimization across the platform. This role sits at the core of building a data-driven competitive advantage by ensuring the platform has the highest quality, most complete, and most actionable data foundation in the market.

While machine learning enables optimization, it is the breadth, accuracy, and structure of the underlying data that ultimately determines performance.

You will drive how vehicle, pricing, and behavioral data are sourced, enriched, standardized, and made usable across the ecosystem—powering everything from search relevance to pricing confidence and marketplace liquidity.

By improving data coverage, reducing inconsistency, and unlocking new signals, you enable faster, more reliable decision-making for both buyers and sellers, creating a compounding advantage that competitors cannot easily replicate. What you will do:
Own data products powering ML models, such as vehicle attributes, condition, and history.
Lead as the connective tissue between Engineering, Data Science, ML teams, and Commercial stakeholders.

Employ a hypothesis-driven approach to product development, converting ambiguity and assumptions into a clear framework for experimentation and validation via experimentation frameworks, including A/B testing, and evaluating offline versus online metrics to measure product and model performance.
Ensure data quality, coverage, and the reliability of underlying models and services that power critical product experiences and business decisions.
Translate complex data from multiple sources—including user behavior, seller performance, and model outputs—into actionable insights that drive product prioritization and innovation.
Improve inventory liquidity, pricing accuracy to drive trust and optimize the marketplace.
Identify high-leverage product opportunities through ranking improvements, data enrichment, and better use of signals to improve relevance, conversion, and customer outcomes.
Guide product strategy by evaluating and clearly communicating critical trade-offs between technical implementation and business value (e.g., performance vs. explainability).
Define and own a 6–12 month roadmap across Data, Search, and ML-driven features.
Articulate and advocate for product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes to executive leadership to secure buy-in and alignment.

4+ years industry (Auto-tech) / Product Management experience
Experience owning data-heavy or technically complex product areas, including data pipelines, schema and event design, platform integrations, and prioritizing product investments that improve data accessibility, usability, and business impact.
Strong understanding of modern data hygiene practices, including data quality management, governance, lineage, validation, and the processes required to ensure trusted, reliable, and scalable data assets across the organization.
Demonstrated success in identifying and implementing LLM-based solutions to augment user workflows, resulting in significant efficiency gains or enhanced capabilities.
Proven track record of leading the end-to-end delivery of complex, technical products, from ideation through to launch and iteration, consistently driving measurable business impact.
Ability to drive product strategy by translating complex data into actionable insights, which requires a strong quantitative toolkit including hands-on proficiency in SQL, rigorous experimentation design, and a deep understanding of metrics architecture
Experience working cross-functionally with engineering teams
Agile experience and release planning prioritization skills

Estudios de Ingeniería Civil Industrial o similares.
Experiencia de al menos 3 años como Product Manager, Product Owner o similar.
Experiencia gestionando productos de software, idealmente con componentes de datos o IA.
Habilidad para levantar requerimientos, priorizar con criterio y conseguir resultados.
Experiencia trabajando con equipos de datos y de análisis en torno a indicadores de negocio.

¡En NeuralWorks nos importa la diversidad! Creemos firmemente en la creación de un ambiente laboral inclusivo, diverso y equitativo. Reconocemos y celebramos la diversidad en todas sus formas y estamos comprometidos a ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades para todos los candidatos.
"Los hombres postulan a un cargo cuando cumplen el 60% de las calificaciones, pero las mujeres sólo si cumplen el 100%." D. Gaucher, J. Friesen and A. C. Kay, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2011.
Te invitamos a postular aunque no cumplas con todos los requisitos.
La posición de Product Manager se enmarca dentro del trabajo de gestión de productos tecnológicos. Te sumarás a un equipo ya constituido, trabajando en conjunto con otras disciplinas tales como Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineers, DevOps, Diseño (UX/UI) y equipos de negocio.
Trabajamos en diferentes proyectos que combinan volúmenes de datos enormes e IA, como detectar y predecir fallas antes que ocurran, optimizar pricing, personalizar la experiencia del cliente, optimizar uso de combustible y objetos usando visión por computador.
Tu trabajo como Product Manager será liderar la definición, priorización y evolución de productos basados en datos e IA, asegurando que resuelvan problemas reales de negocio y de usuario, generando valor medible y alineado con la estrategia de la compañía.

Ser el principal gestor de la medición de impacto de los productos, estimando y relacionando el efecto de las acciones en los principales indicadores de la compañía (Ingreso, Costo, Experiencia de Cliente, Puntualidad, entre otros), utilizando técnicas experimentales y observacionales.
Gestionar, planificar y coordinar los proyectos y portafolios.
Dar seguimiento e informar los avances de la planificación realizada a las diferentes instancias involucradas.
Crear documentos y presentaciones que reflejen el avance del proyecto para los líderes de la organización y asegurar que los planes tácticos de trabajo estén alineados con la estrategia y visión de los líderes.

Experiencia apoyando en el desarrollo de negocios, preparación y liderazgo de propuestas, cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad internos y externos.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
The opportunity
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead the strategy for Trucking Technology—the systems that plan, procure, dispatch, and settle every truck move in North America—and drive the unification of our fragmented ground transportation business into a single Flexport-owned platform by 2027. You will define the vision for how planning, procurement, and carrier experience integrate into one operating system and execute with high autonomy.
This unification is critical for Flexport's long-term vision of an automated supply chain. By owning the full stack, we will consolidate demand, capture leaking margin, and deliver a high-quality experience across modes. You will also drive the next generation of trucking automation—including AI-driven appointment scheduling and automated dispatch—to continue the strategic initiatives in our annual operating plan.
Sitting at the intersection of product, operations, and business, you will be measured by operational and financial impact rather than just features shipped. This role involves redesigning the operating processes themselves and persuading leadership to adopt new models. You will also raise the bar for the PM team through mentorship and sharper frameworks on our most complex product problems.
You will raise the bar for the PM team through mentorship, better frameworks, and sharper thinking on the hardest product problems we face. This is a role for someone with deep product experience, strong analytical instincts, ideally real trucking or ground transportation domain expertise, and the ability to operate at both the strategic and execution level in a complex, data-rich environment.

Own the vision and strategy for Flexport's unified Trucking Technology stack across planning, procurement, pricing, and carrier experience.
Lead the end-to-end trucking unification program, managing cross-domain change management and platform migration risks.
Drive automation and AI initiatives, such as automated dispatch and appointment scheduling, to remove manual work from the cargo lifecycle.
Deliver measurable business impact by optimizing cost-to-serve, procurement savings, and carrier performance metrics.
Reengineer and digitize underlying trucking workflows to establish a leaner operating model.
Modernize the carrier experience to reduce friction across load acceptance, scheduling, and payment touchpoints.
Collaborate with global Engineering, Design, and Operations teams to translate complex logistics workflows into intuitive systems.
Use data-driven frameworks to guide investment and represent your domain in strategic leadership forums.
Mentor PMs to raise the bar for product specs, prioritization, and communication across the team.
What You Should Have
8+ years of PM experience with a track record of owning complex product domains and delivering quantifiable business impact.
Deep expertise in trucking or ground transportation (FTL/LTL, procurement, dispatch, or TMS platforms) is highly desirable.
Experience leading large-scale platform consolidations or system unification programs without disrupting live operations.
Proven ability in operational process engineering—diagnosing, redesigning, and automating complex human workflows.
Strong analytical skills with SQL proficiency and experience building metrics frameworks to drive strategic decisions.
Skilled at shipping intuitive UX in data-dense domains and aligning cross-functional teams around a shared roadmap.
Ability to operate simultaneously at the high-level strategy and granular execution levels.
Excellent communication skills for framing trade-offs and presenting recommendations to senior leadership.
Technical degree (CS, Industrial Engineering) or equivalent technical depth is a plus.

s.h: About the role: What's in the Box
s.t:
As the Senior Product Manager II for Menu Planning within the Operations Mega Alliance, you will own the product layer that decides what lands on HelloFresh menus every week, across markets, brands, and millions of customers.

You will drive the systems and workflows that let our culinary, commercial, and operations teams plan, version, and scale an ever-expanding menu, working back from their needs to build the automation and data foundations that make a larger and more personalized assortment possible.
This is a domain in the middle of a significant platform transformation: you will help move menu planning into a smarter baseline, all while keeping weekly menu delivery running without disruption. You will partner closely with engineering, culinary, procurement, and stakeholders across our largest markets to define a data-driven roadmap, untangle real complexity around regionality and menu customization, and set the long-term vision for how HelloFresh builds its menu at scale.

Own the vision and multi-quarter roadmap for menu planning, turning the needs of culinary, commercial, and operations partners into prioritized initiatives tied to clear business impact.
Build scalable systems and data foundations for menu versioning, regionality, and customization that make a larger, more personalized assortment possible.
Leverage AI and machine learning to automate menu and editorial workflows and sharpen assortment decisions, partnering with data science to take models from concept to production.
Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and senior stakeholders across our largest markets to gather requirements, align in direction, and secure buy-in for strategic bets.
Apply a data-driven approach, using both qualitative and quantitative signals to validate hypotheses, prioritize, and measure outcomes.
Champion product craft as the hands-on expert for menu planning, raising the bar on discovery, prioritization, and execution across the tribe.

Seasoned product experience building and scaling technical or platform products, ideally in a domain with real operational or supply-chain complexity.
Ability to navigate ambiguity , shaping strategy in undefined problem spaces without waiting for a predefined solution.
Data-driven decision-making , comfortable using both qualitative and quantitative signals to validate hypotheses, prioritize, and prove impact.

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.
Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence.
This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction.

You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up.
If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in.
What you’ll be doing
Shape and deliver solutions : Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions.
Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery: Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes.
Work through ambiguity : Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve.
Own product direction: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability.
Collaborate across stakeholders : Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives.
Be developer-obsessed : Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience.

Core experience : You bring 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, a strong technical background that lets you engage deeply with engineering topics, hands-on experience working with APIs, systems, and integrations, and a proven track record of delivering products in close collaboration with engineering teams.
Technical depth : You are comfortable understanding how systems are designed and operate in practice, able to engage in technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs, and willing to go into detail when needed by reviewing flows, investigating issues, or clarifying implementation approaches.
Mindset : You take ownership from problem to outcome, are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving priorities, combine structured thinking with a bias toward action, and can move between big-picture strategy and practical execution.
Collaboration & communication : You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, are comfortable working with experienced, highly engaged stakeholders, and know how to build alignment and drive decisions forward.
Nice to have : It’s a plus if you have had exposure to identity, distributed systems, or similar domains, and experience in fast-paced, product-led environments.
What you’ll get
A team that values ownership, quality, and speed
Close collaboration between product and engineering
Hybrid working model in Berlin + flexible hours
Unlimited vacation

A strong environment to learn, build, and have impact

Team: Product, Research & Design
Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

As we scale our AI Product Group, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take founder-level ownership of the tooling that lets frontier AI model developers conduct cutting-edge research on Prolific.

Increasingly, our AI customers are among the leading AI companies in the world, and this role will additionally lead a team of client-facing engineers dedicated to building strategic integrations and rapid, bespoke development for their most demanding needs.

You'll report into the AI Lead, and join a brilliant team of Product Managers building next-generation AI tooling within our AI Product Group.
Impact: You'll be the Product person accountable for the outcomes of a stream-aligned team building next-gen tooling for frontier AI model developers, and also prioritise for impact the work of a client-facing engineering team. This is a career-defining moment to shape how some of the world's biggest technology companies build AI – no big deal. You'll own how our most strategic AI clients experience Prolific end to end, from product to bespoke integration.
Experience: You'll bring experience building AI native systems, with particular experience building AI native UX. You'll have had success taking complex human workflows and distilling them into highly adaptable technical systems, then scaling access to those systems across multiple interaction surfaces – UI, APIs, CLIs, and MCPs.

You'll also have experience directly managing engineers, ideally in a client-facing or solutions-engineering capacity, and know how to turn a sophisticated client's bespoke needs into a scalable integration rather than a one-off fix.
Domain: You will manage two teams which together give you unmatched closeness and opportunity to build tools for the companies and researchers driving the AI frontier. The Data Collection Tooling team is responsible for building and scaling the systems that enable high-quality human data collection for AI training and evaluation.

Additionally the strategic integrations team interfaces directly with our biggest AI accounts for custom builds. It's critical that the person in this role prioritizes both intuitively and systematically, and is a master at the elegant art of trade-offs between the here and now and the future.
Responsibilities: You'll product manage a stream-aligned team of your own, and lead a team of client-facing engineers delivering strategic integrations and rapid, custom development for our most strategic AI accounts. You'll be accountable for the outcomes of both, and be the key driver of interaction with your peer teams, collaborating across domains of science, research, supply, sales, and account services.
Culture: Adding on to our Prolific Principles, we expect colleagues in the Product, Research, and Design Group to demonstrate reliability, grit, diplomacy, a bias for action, and a dogged focus on value – you'll be a champion of these behaviours yourself, and in the culture of your team. Accountability and autonomy are two sides of the same coin, and we expect you to demonstrate both.
What you'll be doing
Build and launch the next generation of Prolific's Data Collection Tooling product suite.
Lead a team of client-facing engineers delivering strategic integrations and rapid, custom development for our most demanding AI accounts.
Stay up to speed with the rapidly changing face of frontier AI research, keeping your product ahead of customer needs.
Run the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from strategy to success metrics to roadmap, delivery, and iteration – communicating that strategy clearly to executives while working through the details with your team.
Be an unblocker and simplifier of complexity: colleagues will bring you problems, and emerge optimistic, with solutions.
Partner productively with Product Design, User Research, Analytics, and Engineering in a test-learn-iterate fashion.

An extensive and varied track record building AI-native products and UX, including scaling access across multiple interaction surfaces such as UI, APIs, CLIs, and MCPs.
Experience directly managing engineers, ideally in a client-facing or solutions-engineering capacity, and turning sophisticated clients' bespoke needs into scalable integrations.
Fluency in modern Product/Engineering practice: Agile, continuous discovery and delivery, JTBD, vertical slicing, test-learn-iterate.
Strong commercial acumen and data-informed decision-making, paired with a storyteller's flair and a relentless can-do attitude.
Even better if you have
Experience building for or with frontier AI labs or major technology companies.
A track record of giving back to your Product community.
Why Prolific is a great place to work
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.
Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

Your mandate is to rethink the meter usage ingest process end to end, from meter to cash.

Get it right, and a utility bills accurately, at scale, with full auditability; get it wrong, and everything downstream breaks. This is an early-stage, build-it-from-the-ground-up role, and the meter is where you’ll start and not where you’ll stop.

Define how meter data is ingested and reconciled across interval and scalar sources.
Run VEE (validation, editing, estimation) and data-quality guardrails on the way into the core.
Assemble precise billing determinants (kWh, TOU-bucketed kWh, demand kW) for the tariff and billing engines.
Set the standard for how meter data flows through our unified model so that Gigawatt handles interval data and VEE natively in the core, not via a bolt-on MDM.

Own Meter: Drive the roadmap for meter data management end to end, from head-end ingest to billing determinants.

Engage SMEs Translate metering, MDM, and billing expertise into clear specs, enriched with AI-generated documentation and prototypes.

Collaboration: Able to bridge SMEs and engineering; strong communication and structured problem-solving.

Higharc is seeking a hands-on Forward Deployed Product Manager to turn a large production homebuilder's unstructured plan catalog into structured, queryable product data. This is a founding role on a brand-new Forward Deployed team.

A homebuilder's plan library is the product data behind its entire business, and at enterprise scale that data is almost entirely unstructured. Plans live as drawing sets scattered across semi-autonomous divisions, renamed and re-numbered as they move. Nobody can say with confidence which plans are duplicates, how many versions of a given home exist, or what actually varies between them.
Higharc converts those catalogs into structured, queryable plan data and builds the analysis on top of it: searchable plan libraries with agent-enabled natural-language search, geometric similarity scoring that surfaces plans which have forked under different names, structured mapping of what varies across a library, and classification that makes consolidation decisions possible.
You'll own what gets built in the field, working embedded alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers and in partnership with the homebuilder to turn plans into actionable data. This is a role for someone who wants to be close to where the problem lives. Higharc is fully remote; you can sit anywhere in the continental U.S., with travel to client sites and company events up to 30% of the time.

Embed with HQ, regional, and division teams to run discovery—locate plan assets, establish source of truth, and document how each division represents its plans and where variation originates.
Own product definition for the searchable plan library, analytics dashboard, and agent-enabled search—what a good query looks like, what a useful answer looks like, and what "structured for analysis" actually means.
Tune Higharc's Autotranslate AI to identify, categorize, and translate floorplans into data.
Work hands-on with the data: query the structured plan library directly, build against our internal APIs, and ship working capability back to users rather than filing a ticket and waiting.
Define acceptance criteria for delivery milestones—coverage targets, data-field completeness, QA error thresholds—and hold the line on them when schedule pressure argues otherwise.
Frame and defend quantifiable ROI: redundancy across a catalog, dimensional spread on repeated conditions, consolidation candidates, and the purchasing leverage each one represents.
Partner with Forward Deployed Engineering, the Technical Lead, QA, Intake Specialists, and Client Strategy, and present progress and tradeoffs to executive stakeholders.
Capture the playbooks, artifacts, and data patterns that let the forward deployed model carry over to the next engagement.
